title: Resolve IISS legal seat and dated headquarters continuity
summary: Recover authoritative legal-entity/charity records and dated first-party evidence that distinguish the IISS legal or registered seat from its operational headquarters and international offices.

sources.title: Sir John Chipman:A Strategic Lifetime – Introduction

data.target: IISS legal seat and headquarters continuity
data.query: IISS International Institute for Strategic Studies Arundel House registered office legal seat charity company filing headquarters
data.research_question: What authoritative records establish the IISS legal or registered seat, and what dated evidence bounds continuity of the Arundel House headquarters?
objectives: Recover current UK charity/company or other authoritative legal-entity address records
Keep registered office/legal seat distinct from operational headquarters unless the source explicitly equates them
Establish dated continuity or relocation history for the Arundel House headquarters
preferred_sources: IISS annual reports and governance/legal pages
selection_reason: The operational headquarters is now explicitly resolved from first-party evidence
The selected existing organization remains under-enriched on legal-seat and dated-continuity semantics
Separating headquarters from statutory or registered-office evidence prevents future location conflation
